Lindale Power Company — Checking Your Electricity Meter
Customers may check their electricity meter whenever they wish. Doing so can help you verify that your monthly statement is accurate or plan for the cost of your next statement. To check your meter, write down the number shown at the start of the billing period. Then write down the number shown at the end of the billing period. Northgate Gas Utility — How to Read Your Gas Meter
You are welcome to read your gas meter on any day. Reading it regularly can help you make sure that your bill is right or estimate what your next bill will be. To read the meter, note the number on the dial on the first day of your billing cycle. Next, note the number on the last day of the cycle. Brenner Home Goods To Be Reorganized
TORONTO (3 March)—Brenner Home Goods (BHG) announced today that its board of directors has approved a reorganization plan. The plan is intended to lower the company's operating costs, which have risen sharply over the past two years.
Under the plan, BHG will close its garden supply and lighting divisions, which have struggled as shoppers turn to discount chains. The company will concentrate instead on its kitchenware line, which accounts for the largest share of its sales.
The reorganization will be led by the company's current director of operations, Marcus Oyelaran. In May, Mr. Oyelaran will become company president, succeeding Linda Haverford, who is stepping down after twelve years in the role.
BHG currently runs 42 stores in Canada and 15 stores in the United States.

토론토(3월 3일)—브레너 홈 굿즈(BHG)는 오늘 이사회가 조직 개편안을 승인했다고 발표했다. 이 계획은 지난 2년 동안 급격히 늘어난 회사의 운영비를 낮추기 위한 것이다.
계획에 따라 BHG는 쇼핑객들이 할인 체인점으로 옮겨 가면서 고전해 온 원예 용품 사업부와 조명 사업부를 폐쇄한다. 회사는 대신 매출에서 가장 큰 비중을 차지하는 주방용품 제품군에 집중할 것이다.
조직 개편은 회사의 현 운영 이사 마커스 오옐라란이 이끈다. 5월에 오옐라란 씨는 12년간 그 자리를 지킨 뒤 물러나는 린다 해버퍼드의 뒤를 이어 회사 사장이 된다.
BHG는 현재 캐나다에 42개, 미국에 15개 매장을 운영하고 있다.
